name: Constitutional Law
description: Governs the fundamental principles and framework of the state.

name: Criminal Law
description: Deals with offenses, punishments, and legal procedures for crimes.

name: Civil Law
description: Covers disputes between individuals, including property, contracts, and family matters.

name: Corporate & Business Law
description: Regulates companies, trade, and financial transactions.

name: Labor & Employment Law
description: Defines workers' rights, wages, and workplace regulations.

name: Environmental Law
description: Focuses on conservation, pollution control, and sustainable development.

name: Human Rights Law
description: Protects individual freedoms and rights under national and international frameworks.

name: Tax Law
description: Governs taxation policies, duties, and financial regulations.

name: Land & Property Law
description: Covers ownership, tenancy, and land disputes.

name: International Law
description: Deals with treaties, diplomatic relations, and global legal agreements.

name: Intellectual Property Law
description: Protects creations of the mind, including inventions, trademarks, and copyrights.

name: Family Law
description: Covers marriage, divorce, child custody, and related matters.

name: Administrative Law
description: Regulates government agencies and their interactions with the public.

name: Bankruptcy Law
description: Covers insolvency, debt relief, and creditor-debtor relationships.

name: Evidence Law
description: Regulates the admissibility and use of evidence in legal proceedings.

name: Contract Law
description: Governs agreements, obligations, and enforceability of contracts.

name: Tort Law
description: Covers civil wrongs and damages, including negligence and liability.

name: Military Law
description: Regulates the conduct of armed forces and military personnel.

name: Securities Law
description: Regulates the issuance and trading of financial securities.
